work.description: Italian cedola di motu proprio CVIII creating the legation of Velletri for the cardinal bishop of Ostia and Velletri, with numbered §§ I–XIII, derogations, Dato 16130–16131 and the annexed Tabella territoriale 16134–16173 that § I expressly cites (tabella annessa alla presente cedola). LF15666–15675 are provenance citation, signature line, signature number and page-116 running title; 15812/16047/16118 running titles; 15967 page number 100. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF15647. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
